hooks.command: keep prompt session-start --auto-scope -t 'session=${.session_id}' || echo 'keep warning: session-start hook failed; see keep error above.' >&2
keep now 'User prompt: ${.prompt|text}' --truncate --auto-scope -t 'session=${.session_id}' || echo 'keep warning: memory not recorded; see keep error above.' >&2
keep prompt subagent-start --auto-scope -t 'session=${.session_id}' || echo 'keep warning: subagent-start hook failed; see keep error above.' >&2

keep now 'Assistant response: ${.last_assistant_message}' --truncate --auto-scope --quiet -t 'session=${.session_id}' >/dev/null || echo 'keep warning: memory not recorded; see keep error above.' >&2; echo '{}'

keep now 'Subagent response: ${.last_assistant_message}' --truncate --auto-scope --quiet -t 'session=${.session_id}' >/dev/null || echo 'keep warning: memory not recorded; see keep error above.' >&2; echo '{}'
